question: What causal mechanisms remain promising for improving real-tender LD matching after the current champion and prior experiments?
findings: The active production path retrieves with the original query plus at most one canonical alternate, fuses dense/BM25 candidates into a fixed top-20, then reranks against the untouched original query. Canonicalization is therefore retrieval-only and fail-open. In the reconstructed 130-row review set, 53 rows mention ball valves, 50 threaded/inch-style cues, 43 third-party brands (30 IVR), 33 filter/water-treatment rows, and 11 explicit service-action rows. Only 40/130 currently receive a canonical alternate. The catalog contains 15,788 products, including substantial ball-valve and butterfly coverage, but no IVR/VALTEC/TECOFI/БИВАЛ tokens; it has no cartridge or water-treatment products, while its 129 “filter” products are principally грязевики. A confirmed parser defect truncates “Кран БИВАЛ КШТ.11.050.025.ф/ф 50х25 КОФ” to “Кран БИВАЛ К”: the clause-end quantity pattern can recognize embedded “ШТ.” without a required leading token boundary. This is a general parsing error, not a one-off rule. No new evidence supports another branded-model suppression or source-enrichment refinement: three such attempts already increased hidden wrong-NOT_FOUND rate despite retaining original-query retrieval.
decision_impact: The main uncertainty is whether useful unresolved value is constrained by loss of query evidence during normalization and late fusion, or by genuine catalog-scope/service-consumable requests that should produce uncertainty rather than more retrieval. The Planner should distinguish these mechanisms. Do not select another endpoint/inch, branded-token suppression, or manufacturer-model enrichment variant without new causal evidence; those paths are already tested and unsafe.
unresolved: The review corpus is unresolved rather than outcome-labeled, so its category counts establish opportunity and scope but not end-to-end uplift. The supplied review-pool gzip remains corrupt; membership is reconstructable from the intact all-rows, labels, and provisional-NOT_FOUND files. It is also unmeasured whether correcting the canonical alternate changes the final top-20, because the original query is retained and may already supply the needed candidate.

evidence_patterns.pattern: Narrow additive retrieval normalization has conditional value; semantic expansion is not generally beneficial.
supporting_experiments: legacy-cycle-3 ACCEPTED: deterministic query canonicalization improved safely.
legacy-cycle-4 ACCEPTED: standalone WW expansion improved safely.
legacy-cycle-6 REJECTED: flanged-shorthand canonicalization regressed hidden safety.
legacy-cycle-9 REJECTED: standard-bore wording expansion was neutral.
legacy-cycle-17 REJECTED: installed-electric versus actuator-ready alternate had an unreliable catalog semantic premise.
evidence_patterns.interpretation: The successful causal path is preservation/translation of unambiguous catalog vocabulary, not adding plausible domain semantics. The present parser truncation directly destroys source evidence inside that proven retrieval-only path, so repairing it is materially different from adding another alias.

evidence_patterns.pattern: Changes that alter candidate composition or final compatibility selection have repeatedly failed to improve end-to-end utility.
supporting_experiments: legacy cycles 1-2: broad filtering and compatibility-evidence intervention regressed.
legacy-cycle-5 REJECTED: evidence-first reranker rubric regressed blind safety.
legacy-cycle-8 REJECTED: deterministic post-rerank compatibility substitution was neutral.
legacy-cycle-16 REJECTED: candidate diversification regressed public coverage.
legacy-cycle-7 REJECTED: catalog structural representation reduced hidden coverage.
evidence_patterns.interpretation: The evidence does not show that more candidate filtering, compatibility gating, prompt changes, diversification, or catalog rewriting is the current bottleneck. A new decision/abstention layer would need a sharply separable request-intent signal, not generic technical compatibility rules.

evidence_patterns.pattern: Branded tender nomenclature is common, but prior genericization and external-fact enrichment were unsafe.
supporting_experiments: attempt-01 alias_mapping REJECTED: threaded/inch expansion increased hidden wrong-NOT_FOUND rate by 0.04.
attempt-02 alias_mapping REJECTED: supplier/model-noise suppression increased hidden wrong-NOT_FOUND rate by 0.04.
attempt-03 alias_mapping REJECTED: trusted manufacturer/model facts increased hidden wrong-NOT_FOUND rate by 0.08.
evidence_patterns.interpretation: Opaque brand/model text is a real corpus mismatch, but making it more generic or importing source facts did not establish LD interchangeability and degraded safety. This points to underspecification/equivalence uncertainty rather than a simple lexical-recall deficit.

evidence_patterns.pattern: A distinct non-catalog/service class is large enough to compete with more retrieval work.
supporting_experiments: Real-corpus inspection: 33 review rows are filter/water-treatment related; examples include cartridges, filter media, water-treatment units, and service work.
Catalog inspection: zero catalog texts contain cartridge/ЭФГ or water-treatment terms; 129 filter entries are largely грязевики.
Real-corpus inspection: 11 review rows explicitly request removal, repair, installation, or maintenance.
evidence_patterns.interpretation: For many rows, better retrieval cannot create a compatible sellable LD product. Yet action words alone are insufficient, because some installation/removal lines mention a product family; any intervention must establish service-only or absent-capability evidence affirmatively.

candidate_directions.causal_mechanism: Repair structural line-item/quantity boundary parsing so a canonical retrieval alternate cannot stop inside an alphanumeric technical designation; retain the raw query, all existing canonical transformations, and final reranking behavior.
candidate_directions.competing_explanation: Because raw-query retrieval remains active, the damaged alternate may not materially affect candidate availability or final selection; the observed defect may be operationally harmless on most rows.
candidate_directions.falsifier: A stratified real-tender retrieval comparison shows that preserving affected designations does not add or improve viable family-consistent candidates in the pre-rerank pool, while public/hidden gates remain flat.
candidate_directions.information_gain: High confidence in correctness and moderate information gain: it isolates whether an established successful mechanism is currently losing evidence through parsing rather than through retrieval or reranking.

candidate_directions.causal_mechanism: Represent original and canonical retrieval hits as separate evidence channels through fusion, rather than collapsing each modality to one locally best rank before RRF; reward candidates corroborated by both query forms without removing candidates or changing reranker semantics.
candidate_directions.competing_explanation: The primary limitation may be candidate absence or reranker choice, so preserving alternate-query corroboration may not alter the fixed top-20 meaningfully; candidate-composition changes have previously been risky.
candidate_directions.falsifier: On a real-tender stratification of rows with canonical alternates, variant-aware fusion does not improve family/constraint-consistent candidate presence or rank, or it breaches public/hidden coverage or safety gates.
candidate_directions.information_gain: Moderate-to-high: it tests an untried architectural implication of the accepted canonicalization mechanism while avoiding another semantic expansion or index rebuild.

candidate_directions.causal_mechanism: Use affirmative evidence of service-only procurement or a request category absent from the LD product taxonomy to route toward an uncertain/NOT_FOUND outcome, while allowing lines that name an actual purchasable product to continue through ordinary retrieval.
candidate_directions.competing_explanation: Tender work descriptions can embed an intended product, and catalog lexical fields can be noisy; a router could convert recoverable matches into wrong NOT_FOUND, reproducing prior selection-adjacent regressions.
candidate_directions.falsifier: A manually reviewed non-benchmark sample shows material overlap between the proposed service/absent-category cues and viable LD product requests, or regression gates show increased wrong-NOT_FOUND.
candidate_directions.information_gain: High: it separates genuine catalog noncoverage from retrieval failure in the sizeable consumable, water-treatment, and service portion of the real corpus.
